mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and suppresses valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 3.5% for 2 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in nonfarm payrolls signal labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of periods with UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising residential construction permits signal strong household demand that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of late-cycle periods with HOUST rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past month indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in >60% of INDPRO rise periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >60% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI inflation and residential sales indicate strong aggregate demand that boosts corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of CPIAUCSL and RSAFS rise periods, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In high labor market tightness regimes, unemployment rate falling below 4.0% signals strengthening labor conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate hiring, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of periods with UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
